trip_query_fixture.runtime: Node v24.19.0 SQLite with a result-projection probe
trip_query_fixture.tradeoff: Long scans can issue additional bounded queries. Pages grow up to 8192 to limit cursor churn; complete trip grouping continues across pages.
trip_query_fixture.limits: SQL projection counts, not Android latency, physical I/O, battery or a fleet usage rate. History, trip contents, free/VIP limits and generation guards are preserved.

pending_route_publication.limits: Unit publication callbacks, not a native GPU/battery benchmark. Retains one prior immutable collection; equality checks all features and coordinates. Expiry and matching are unchanged.

private_gpx_cursor_filter.change: Apply existing inclusive timestamp cutoffs in SQL while retaining trip-ID bounds, ordering and writer guard.
private_gpx_cursor_filter.query_plan_probe: Both queries use INTEGER PRIMARY KEY row-ID range traversal with the timestamp index present.
private_gpx_cursor_filter.limits: No output-format, padding, entitlement, sampling or generation-rule change. No latency or transfer percentage measured.

weekly_rewards.limits: BEFORE INSERT probe counts attempted inserts. No claim that ignored conflicts previously rewrote production reward rows. Same transaction, unique keys, payouts and weekly grace.

verification_response_buffer.limits: Removes one response-body copy, not an attestation call or provider credit. Verified competition is optional and disabled in ordinary Android builds.

limits: No measured physical-device battery percentage, whole-app speedup, new supplier allowance, DAU capacity or daily driving-hours gain.
